summary: Harden staged provider reporting, MFA continuation, storage migrations, and MCP read-only behavior.
reason: Live PG&E validation showed MFA delivery options are returned by the login challenge and the CLI executes MFA phases in separate processes. Review also identified incomplete-hour persistence, mutable MCP exposure, migration loss, and error-propagation risks.
validated_outcome: Focused regressions, full Go tests/vet/build, live Go PG&E email MFA plus session-backed collection, and read-only MCP verification pass.
